title: LIVE UPDATES: Impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte
summary: Bookmark this page for Rappler's comprehensive coverage of Vice President Sara Duterte's impeachment trial at the Senate

blocks.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte — the first Philippine public official to be impeached twice by the House of Representatives — began at 2 pm on Monday, July 6.

There are four articles of impeachment against Duterte involving alleged misuse of confidential funds, unexplained wealth, bribery of Department of Education officials, and grave threats against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and his family.

Only 21 out of 24 senator-judges are physically present. Senator Bato dela Rosa remains in hiding as he faces an International Criminal Court arrest warrant over Rodrigo Duterte’s drug war, Senator Jinggoy Estrada has been detained and suspended in connection with a plunder case, and Senator Rodante Marcoleta surrendered to authorities as he also faces a plunder case.
On this page, we bring you the latest updates, analyses, videos, and photos as the trial of the Vice President unfolds.

blocks.text: LATEST UPDATES
10 minutes ago
Is Sara Duterte unaware of BPI accounts with father Rodrigo?

What did the defense team — and the Vice President, for that matter — accomplish in claiming that Sara Duterte had no knowledge of the joint bank accounts with her father, who was detained in The Hague? House prosecutor Terry Ridon had a response that mirrored the thought balloon of many trial observers that day: “Magandang araw po, Pangulong Duterte. Nilalaglag po kayo rito.”
22 minutes ago
Prosecution holds press conference after bank execs’ testimonies | October 8, 2026

The prosecution team holds a press conference on Thursday, October 8, after bank executives took the witness stand and talked about the accounts of Vice President Sara Duterte and her spouse, Manases Carpio.

blocks.text: 59 minutes ago
LIVE: Sara Duterte impeachment trial – Day 36 Special Coverage | October 8, 2026
The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte continues on Day 36, on Wednesday, October 8.
Rappler’s special coverage brings updates, analyses, and commentary from Rappler reporters, hosted by Rappler columnist John Nery, and joined by constitutional lawyer and law professor Lulu Reyes.
1 hour ago
Rappler Recap: Prosecution flags alleged ‘scheme’ to hide millions in time deposits

The prosecution presents bank records showing how large time deposits linked to Vice President Sara Duterte and her father, former president Rodrigo Duterte, were converted into manager’s checks on Wednesday, October 7, 2026.
Rappler multimedia reporter Sundy Locus reports on the alleged scheme, the bank witnesses’ testimony, and why the prosecution dropped four of its expected bank witnesses.

blocks.text: 2 hours ago
Rappler Recap: COA affirms P73M Sara Duterte confidential fund disallowance

The Commission on Audit has upheld with finality the disallowance of P73 million in confidential funds spent by Vice President Sara Duterte’s office, with P69.78 million used for rewards and P3.5 million for equipment and furniture, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026.

Rappler multimedia reporter Jairo Bolledo reports on the COA ruling, its relevance to the Vice President’s impeachment case, and the defense’s efforts to distance Duterte from the bank accounts and investments presented in court that day

blocks.text: 11 hours ago
Are alleged undeclared assets in Sara Duterte’s SALNs ‘smoking gun’ in impeachment trial?

With the prosecution’s presentation of Vice President Sara Duterte’s alleged undeclared assets in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth, is the trial really far from over, as the defense insists?

Former Integrated Bar of the Philippines president and expert litigator Antonio Pido says in a Rappler panel discussion after the impeachment trial on October 7, 2026, that this would all depend on how the defense counters the prosecution’s presentation.

blocks.text: 12 hours ago
Ridon: Sara Duterte’s defense team threw father, husband under the bus

House prosecutor Terry Ridon says the defense appeared to distance Vice President Sara Duterte from her father, former president Rodrigo Duterte, and her husband, Mans Carpio, by saying she was unaware of their bank accounts and financial activities on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, Day 35 of the impeachment trial.

blocks.text: 13 hours ago
Ex-IBP president: Public needs to pay attention to impeachment proceedings

Former Integrated Bar of the Philippines national president Antonio Pido says the public needs to pay more attention to the impeachment proceedings so they can exact accountability from Vice President Sara Duterte.

“Kailangan makinig sila kasi obligado ang bise presidente na sundin ang batas, including the SALN law,” says the expert litigator on Wednesday, October 7, during Rappler’s special coverage of Duterte’s impeachment trial.
